$note: Expected SASS instruction patterns for SM70 Flash Attention forward kernel optimization methods. Used by sass_check.py to verify that claimed optimizations actually appear in compiled code. require_any=true means at least one pattern must match; require_any=false means all patterns must match. Empty sass_patterns means SASS-level verification is not applicable (verified by ncu metrics instead).

memory.bank_conflict_swizzle.note: Shared store/load instructions — must verify swizzle XOR pattern in address calculation. Bank conflict reduction is verified by ncu, not SASS.

memory.pad_smem_layout.note: Padding changes stride in STS instructions. Need to compare STS address offsets between baseline and optimized.

memory.tiling_smem.note: Tile size affects loop count and register usage. Verified by smaller grid size and changed register count, not specific SASS patterns.

memory.vectorized_access.note: Vectorized global load/store. LDG.E.128 = 128-bit (optimal for SM70). LDG.E.64 = 64-bit (suboptimal). Should see LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU.

memory.reduce_smem_usage.note: Verified by reduced shared memory allocation (check SASS header's SMEM directive) and changed occupancy in ncu.

memory.cache_modifier.note: Cache modifier appears as suffix on LDG instructions. .GPU = .cg (cache global), .SYS = .cv (volatile), .CTA = .ca (cache all).

memory.layout_transpose_optimize.note: V transpose may use SHFL for in-register transpose or STS/LDS for smem-based transpose. Check for reduced instruction count.

compute.reduce_register_pressure.note: Verified by reduced register count in SASS header and increased occupancy in ncu. No specific SASS instruction pattern.

compute.increase_tile_size.note: HMMA.884.F32.F16 is the SM70 Tensor Core instruction (8x8x4 FP16 MMA). Larger tiles → more HMMA instructions per iteration.

compute.tc_mma_atom_optimize.note: SM70 only supports HMMA.884.F32.F16 (FP16) and HMMA.884.F32.F32 (FP32). Verify correct variant for data type.

compute.fragment_conversion_optimize.note: C→A fragment conversion uses warp shuffle. Optimization reduces SHFL count or replaces with different SHFL variant.

compute.softmax_sfu_optimize.note: MUFU.EX2 = exp2 SFU instruction. Replaces MUFU.EX (if that exists) or software exp() sequence.

compute.loop_unroll_pragma.note: Unrolling removes branches. Count: fewer BRA/BRX instructions in hot loop = better unrolling. verify_min_count should be 0 for the main loop.

latency.mio_throttle_reduce.note: MIO throttle reduction = fewer shared memory instructions. Count STS+LDS and compare to baseline.

latency.reduce_sync_barrier.note: BAR.SYNC = __syncthreads(). Fewer BAR.SYNC instructions = reduced sync barrier.

latency.pipeline_depth.note: Pipeline depth verified by interleaving of LDG (load) and HMMA (compute) in SASS disassembly order.

latency.warp_specialization_sm70.note: SM70 warp specialization uses BAR.SYNC for producer-consumer coordination. Check that some warps do LDG-heavy work while others do HMMA-heavy work.

latency.early_exit_optimize.note: Early exit = branch out of main loop. Verified by branch pattern in SASS.

tc_mma.note: SM70 Tensor Core FP16 MMA: 8x8x4. Should appear in pairs for each MMA atom invocation in TiledMMA.

global_load_128.note: 128-bit cached global load, bypassing L1. Used for Q, K, V streaming reads.

global_store_128.note: 128-bit global store. Used for O output and P (softmax_lse) output.

shared_store_128.note: 128-bit shared store. Used for writing Q/K/V tiles to smem. Bank conflicts visible in ncu.

shared_load_128.note: 128-bit shared load. Used for MMA input reads from smem.

warp_shuffle.note: Warp shuffle instructions. Key to C→A fragment conversion in convert_layout_C_to_A_v2.

fp32_fma.note: FP32 FMA instruction. Used in softmax rescaling and accumulator operations.

sfu_ex2.note: SFU exp2 instruction. Used in online softmax for exponentiation.

barrier_sync.note: Thread block barrier. Each __syncthreads() = one BAR.SYNC.

fp16_conversion.note: FP16 ↔ FP32 conversion. F2F.F16.F32 = half→float, F2F.F32.F16 = float→half.
